Check and control: [ ] M — The current dossier list and core forms have been resolved for the exact route.
Pass evidence and failure action: Build the list from the current regulation, calendar and faculty instructions. Verify source, revision, title, candidate details, signature, copies, channel and deadline. Do not reuse a prior session’s checklist. Sources E1–E6.

Check and control: [ ] C — All status-triggered forms, fees and alternative channels are resolved.
Pass evidence and failure action: Distinguish previous cohort, additional year, mobility, identity change, lost account access and other activated conditions. Retain the competent instruction and evidence. Sources E1, E2, E5, E6 and, when the mobility-only route is triggered, E9–E10.

Check and control: [ ] M — The validated final PDF was transmitted on time through the authorised channel and opens independently.
Pass evidence and failure action: Retain the actual sent or downloaded object, timestamp, recipient or platform, identifier and receipt. Compare its hash or controlled identity with the validated file. Sources E1, E2 and E4–E7.

Check and control: [ ] M — The registration dossier was delivered in the official window and through the correct route.
Pass evidence and failure action: Record date, place or platform, receiving unit and items delivered. Separate scientific-file transmission from dossier delivery where both are required. Sources E1, E2 and E4–E6.

Check and control: [ ] M — Document verification and enrolment are confirmed.
Pass evidence and failure action: Retain the identifiable confirmation issued after review of the dossier. Check candidate, route, session and status. Absence of confirmation remains PENDING and requires follow-up before the examination. Sources E1, E2, E5, E6 and, when the mobility-only route is triggered, E9–E10.

Check and control: [ ] M — Exact title and candidate identity agree across official objects.
Pass evidence and failure action: Compare application, departmental record, final PDF, declarations, receipts and scheduling list. Resolve discrepancies in writing before the defence. Sources E1, E2, E5, E6 and, when the mobility-only route is triggered, E9–E10.

Check and control: [ ] R — Interface state and conflicting instructions have been controlled.
Pass evidence and failure action: A button state, hidden menu, mobile error or screenshot alone is not proof of success or failure. Mark competing official values CONFLICT, pause the action and retain dated written clarification. Source E7.

Check and control: [ ] R — Account continuity and administrative privacy are protected.
Pass evidence and failure action: Where institutional access may expire, export only permitted records and confirm an authorised alternative route. Keep identity copies, signatures, civil-status records, fee evidence and personal confirmations in the restricted dossier. Sources E5–E7.
